# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, critique ideas rather than people, and keep
discussions on topic. Harassment, insults, personal attacks and publishing other people's private information
are not acceptable, in issues, pull requests, discussions or any other project space.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainers through GitHub (the *Report content* option on the
comment or issue, or a private security advisory if it involves a vulnerability). Reports are handled
confidentially. Maintainers may remove content and temporarily or permanently ban participants who break these
rules, following the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant.
